title: Bonn intracranial EEG segments, sets C, D and E (Andrzejak et al. 2001)
description: This dataset contains 300 single-channel intracranial EEG segments (23.6 s each, 173.61 Hz) from five epilepsy patients, drawn from the Bonn EEG data of Andrzejak et al. (2001). It covers sets C and D (interictal, hippocampal formation and epileptogenic zone) and set E (ictal activity). Sets A and B (scalp EEG from healthy volunteers) are excluded. The data are a lossless BIDS re-packaging of the published text files, pooled under one pseudo-subject because segment-to-patient mapping is not available.
methods_description: Segments were cut from continuous multichannel presurgical EEG recordings after visual artifact inspection and a weak-stationarity criterion. They were recorded with a 128-channel amplifier system and average common reference, digitized at 12 bits and 173.61 Hz, with band-pass filtering at 0.53-40 Hz. Depth electrodes were placed in the hippocampal formations and strip electrodes on the neocortex. The source text files were converted to BrainVision format without filtering, resampling, re-referencing or rescaling.
